description: Defines the VideoDecodePerfHistory class responsible for managing video decode performance statistics, including saving, retrieving, and grading performance data via a database, within the media namespace. It interfaces with Mojo for IPC and includes methods for database initialization, performance assessment, and UKM reporting.

classes.name: VideoDecodePerfHistory
classes.description: Manages video decode performance data, including database interactions, performance grading, and IPC via Mojo.

methods.name: BindReceiver
methods.description: Binds a Mojo receiver to this instance for IPC.

methods.name: GetPerfInfo
methods.description: Retrieves performance info based on prediction features.

methods.name: GetSaveCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback for saving performance records.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Clears all stored performance history from the database.

methods.name: GetVideoDecodeStatsDB
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying video decode stats database.
